summary: Retest of PMSC 2026 rebrand after iteration_82 fixes (UF_PROVA->SC, homepage date 16/11, edital-card brasao on 3 pages). All 3 fixes verified. Ran the full public inscricao flow in the browser: pmpe.html (closed #avisoOk modal) -> Inscreva-se -> termos.html?c=pmpe (#termos, #bt-continuar) -> inscricao.html (filled NOME/CPF random-valid/DATA_NASCIMENTO/SEXO/CEP autofill/NUMERO/CELULAR/EMAIL/DOC_TIPO=RG/#DOC_FRENTE/#DOC_VERSO/#declaracao_veracidade, submit btn-continuar-inscricao) -> dados-inscricao.html (#VAGA=201, #MUNICIPIO_PROVA=FLORIANOPOLIS, term checkbox, btn-cadastrar) -> confirmacao.html (btn-confirmar-inscricao, conf-success-ok) -> inscricao-realizada.html. Flow completed with no errors. Backend pytest tests/test_pmsc_rebrand.py = 13/13 green; obsolete tests/test_telegram_title_pmpe_cbmpe.py confirmed deleted.
verified_fixes: CRITICAL REGRESSION FIXED: after picking the SC prova city, confirmacao.html 'ESTADO DA PROVA' reads 'Santa Catarina' (CIDADE: FLORIANOPOLIS/SC). The hidden #UF_PROVA value read 'SC' after city select. Backend persistence verified in Mongo cadastros: form_data.UF_PROVA='SC', MUNICIPIO_PROVA='FLORIANOPOLIS/SC' (no longer 'AP'/Amapa).
Homepage inicio.html card now reads 'Inscricoes abertas ate 16/11/2026 as 23h59' (15/11/2026 no longer present).

edital-card brasao img.aec-brasao (data-c-src='logo', /idcap/img/pmsc-logo.png) now renders on inscricao.html, dados-inscricao.html and confirmacao.html with naturalWidth=366 (>0) next to 'PMSC 2026' / 'Policia Militar de Santa Catarina'.
No page in the flow shows visible 'Pernambuco'/'PMPE'/'CBMPE'; headers read 'PMSC 2026' / 'Policia Militar de Santa Catarina'.
Backend pytest tests/test_pmsc_rebrand.py 13/13 PASSED; tests/test_telegram_title_pmpe_cbmpe.py removed from suite.
critical_code_review_comments: test_pmsc_rebrand.py reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at import time and crashes collection if the env var is unset; pytest must be run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (I sourced it from frontend/.env). Minor: guard with a default-skip.

The blank/fresh confirmacao.html (empty sessionStorage) still fires btn-confirmar and shows inscricao-realizada with number 2026000000 and empty Nome/CPF/Cargo; it did NOT persist an inscricoes record, so harmless, but confirmacao could guard against submitting with no form_data.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md present (admin donas). Not needed for public flow.
seed_data_creation: Created test inscricao CPF 03854992211 / 'TEST PMSC CANDIDATO' via the UI, then deleted it by exact cpf+nome filter from cadastros (1) and registrations (2); no inscricoes record existed. Verified 0 remaining with that cpf. Known side effect: btn-cadastrar may have sent 1 real Telegram notification (expected per briefing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration_82 bugs are fixed and verified end-to-end. UF_PROVA now persists as 'SC'.
